tools.name: find_feedback_emails

tools.name: analyze_feedback_sentiment
tools.description: Run sentiment analysis on the text of a feedback email and classify it as positive, negative, or neutral.

tools.name: get_routing_config_rows
tools.description: Read the routing rule rows from the FB-Routing-Config-2026 spreadsheet mapping each sentiment to a team channel.

tools.description: Send a notification to the destination channel owner that feedback has been routed to their queue.

tools.description: List the available team Slack channels and their IDs and membership for reference.
